chars.RANIA: RANIA: a young woman wearing a mustard-yellow oversized hoodie, light blue jeans and white sneakers.
chars.KARIM: KARIM: a young man wearing a dark green bomber jacket with an orange lining, black jeans and a grey beanie.
chars.BROTHER: BROTHER: a tall young man wearing a red-and-black checked flannel shirt, dark grey trousers and a black wristwatch.
chars.FRIENDS: FRIENDS: two young women, one wearing a lilac knitted cardigan, the other a teal denim jacket.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: At a small table on a Moroccan cafe terrace with mint tea glasses, KARIM leans toward RANIA with a worried serious face, holding out his smartphone toward her as he quietly tells her something important. Moroccan city street with arches in the background.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: RANIA sits frozen at the cafe table staring at a smartphone in her hands, eyes wide and mouth open in shock, a mint tea glass knocked over on the table. Moroccan cafe terrace background.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: In her modern Moroccan bedroom, RANIA stands furious, shouting angrily into her smartphone held to her ear, her other hand raised in a fist, her face red with anger.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: In a busy Moroccan street at evening, several young people stand in small groups looking at their phones and whispering to each other with surprised gossiping faces, passing a phone from hand to hand.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: At night in her bedroom, RANIA anxiously throws clothes into an open suitcase on her bed, a window behind her showing a dark sky with a distant airplane light, her face scared and panicked.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: In a cozy Moroccan living room with a traditional sedari sofa, the two FRIENDS sit beside a worried RANIA, one with a comforting hand on her shoulder, the other offering her a glass of water, trying to calm her down.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: In the dim hallway of a Moroccan family apartment, the BROTHER stands still staring down at his smartphone, his face dark and furious, jaw clenched, the screen glow lighting his face, a closed bedroom door behind him.
